title: Tanqeel's 90-Day Path
subtitle: A2/B1 → B2+ · English for client calls

phases.focus: Module 0 + Foundations: placement, learning system, sound-first base.
Accuracy: tense, articles, prepositions, sentence surgery.
Pronunciation: the sounds that decide whether clients understand you.
Fluency: thinking in English, fast small talk, no translating.
Client communication: discovery calls, updates, problem talk.
Sales + final mock call: close like a professional.
Everyday & social fluency: small talk, travel, living abroad, phone calls.
Workplace English: meetings, presentations, emails, feedback, interviews.
IELTS mastery: 4-section technique + 2 full mock tests. Band 7+ needs B2+ — technique stacks on foundation.

weeks.focus: Placement test + first lessons. Find your level, build the daily habit.
Present simple + past simple. Short, correct sentences.
weeks.milestone: Describe your studies in 5 correct sentences.

weeks.focus: Present perfect + future forms. Talk about experience and plans.
weeks.milestone: Say what you have done and what you will do — correctly.

weeks.focus: Articles (a/an/the). The tiny words that mark B2.
Prepositions: time, place, movement + verb chunks.
TH, v/w, word stress. The sounds that decide understanding.
Rhythm, linking, intonation. Sound natural, not robotic.
weeks.milestone: Record a 60-second intro that sounds smooth.

weeks.focus: Chunking + thinking in English. Stop translating.
weeks.milestone: Answer 5 quick questions with zero Urdu in your head.

weeks.focus: Small talk + opinions. Keep a conversation alive.
weeks.milestone: Hold 3 minutes of small talk without freezing.

weeks.focus: Discovery calls: questions that uncover client needs.
Updates, delays, problems. Honest professional talk.

weeks.milestone: Record a 60-second intro you're proud of.

weeks.focus: Pricing, objections, closing + final mock call.
weeks.milestone: Final mock call — close like a professional. 🎉

weeks.focus: Small talk, travel scripts, living abroad, phone-call recovery.
weeks.milestone: Hold a 3-minute small-talk conversation without freezing.

weeks.focus: Meetings, presentations, workplace writing, feedback, interviews.
Listening + Reading technique: traps, prediction, T/F/NG logic.
Writing + Speaking: Task 1/2 frameworks, cue-card method, 2 full mocks.
weeks.milestone: Full IELTS mock — score yourself with the band rubrics. 🎓
